pages.text: Right-click with an empty hand to lie down (head to the headboard). Sneak to get up. A dragged patient — Shift+right-click.

On a bed: wounds heal $(cfg)1.5$() times faster, blood regenerates $(cfg)1.5$() times faster, the brain $(cfg)2$() times faster, fewer infections (×$(cfg)0.7$()).$(br2)Beds from other mods work as hospital beds too.
